verdicts.reason: A: the headline runs almost edge to edge with thin side margins. The legal line is large, sits between the subhead and the CTA, and competes with the subhead. The SOLSTICE logo is shrunk and pushed into the top-right corner, where it reads as an afterthought next to the bigger sale banner. The bottle is small and floats in empty space. B: the logo is oversized and fights the sale banner for attention at the top, and the banner is crammed into the top-right corner against the grey circle. The legal text still sits above the CTA, though it is smaller and more clearly secondary. B's headline margins, centred column and spacing are cleaner, so it is the less flawed resize.
